_comment: Source repos for skillsync. Third-party marketplaces are blocked by enterprise
are cloned locally and installed as plain user-level skills/commands/agents.
dir  - directory name under root; load-bearing, <dir>.skillsync filters key off it
url  - https, not git@: a fresh Coder workspace has no GitHub SSH key
ref  - branch or tag to track
pin  - exact SHA for reproducibility, or null to follow the tip of ref
To update: cd <clone> && git pull, then update pin here and commit.
